title: Weather worsens, then eases
description: Rainfall and wind rise sharply over Zone C, then Zones A and B, before easing. Each worsening step must trigger reassessment of incidents in that zone and a weather_worsening alert.

steps.note: Severe worsening over Zone C: wind crosses the 50 km/h threshold (+2 weather points).
steps.forecast_summary: Very heavy rain and strong winds for the next 6 hours

steps.note: Zone A worsens; INC-001 must be reassessed.
steps.forecast_summary: Very heavy rain and strong winds for the next 6 hours

steps.note: Zone B worsens; INC-002 (and INC-004) must be reassessed.
steps.forecast_summary: Very heavy rain and strong winds for the next 6 hours

steps.note: Easing: warning lifted, rain moderate. Scores may drop; no worsening alert expected.
steps.forecast_summary: Moderate rain easing to showers over the next 6 hours

expected: Each worsening step creates a weather_worsening alert naming the zone
Incidents in the affected zone are reassessed; the Weather/escalation factor rises from 13 to 15 (wind >= 50 km/h)
The easing step lowers the weather factor and does not raise a worsening alert
